workflow_name: Table Data Ingestion and Source Processing
workflow_description: Handles the extraction of data from diverse sources such as POCOs, dictionaries, and standard lists while enforcing structural integrity between columns and rows.
Determines the internal dimensions and alignment of the table by calculating Unicode character widths, handling word-wrapping, and applying numeric data policies.
Manages the final visual representation of the data, including style selection, summary footer visibility, and routing the formatted table to the system output.
